general.title: Analysis options
general.instructions: Every field is optional and ships with a working default, so running with no parameters at all produces the standard analysis. This capsule emits plot-ready CSVs (resampled.csv, instrument_summary.csv, anomalies.csv) — the charts are drawn by the app that reads them, not here.

parameters.name: Resample interval
parameters.description: Bucket size the readings are resampled into before smoothing and anomaly detection. Larger buckets mean fewer, smoother points.

parameters.name: Rolling window (buckets)
parameters.description: How many resampled buckets the rolling mean averages over. Whole number, 1 or more; 1 disables smoothing.

parameters.name: Anomaly threshold (robust z)
parameters.description: Flag a bucket when the robust z-score of its residual (bucket mean minus rolling mean) reaches this magnitude. Lower finds more.

parameters.name: Top N anomalies
parameters.description: How many of the flagged buckets, ranked by |robust z| descending, are written to anomalies.csv.

parameters.name: Baseline instrument
parameters.description: Instrument id every other instrument's mean is compared against, e.g. RX-101. It sets the mean_vs_baseline column of instrument_summary.csv (this instrument's mean minus the baseline's, 0 on the baseline row itself), so changing it changes the results. Blank means the first instrument alphabetically; an id that is not in the data warns and falls back to that. The instrument actually used is recorded in manifest.json.
